mentorship.signup_terms_intro: Mentorship in AlumVerse is a non-profit connection activity between mentor and mentee to support academic orientation, career, and skill development. AlumVerse acts as an intermediary platform supporting connection, appointment management, and feedback recording; the content exchanged during mentoring sessions is the responsibility of the participating parties.
mentorship.signup_terms_agree_header: By using the Mentorship feature, users agree to:
mentorship.signup_terms_commitment_1: Provide honest, clear profile information appropriate to the mentoring purpose.
mentorship.signup_terms_commitment_2: Not use mentorship for advertising, solicitation, unauthorized charging, or providing services outside the platform.
mentorship.signup_terms_commitment_3: Respect the other party's time, respond to bookings within a reasonable time, and give early notice for cancellations/reschedules.
mentorship.signup_terms_commitment_4: Keep personal or sensitive information shared during mentoring confidential.
mentorship.signup_terms_commitment_5: Not use harassing, discriminatory, abusive, or unlawful language or behavior.
mentorship.signup_terms_commitment_6: Allow the system to record session history, feedback, and reports to improve mentorship quality and resolve disputes if any.
mentorship.signup_terms_penalty: If a mentor or mentee books but does not attend, cancels repeatedly, or behaves inappropriately, AlumVerse reserves the right to warn, restrict, or temporarily suspend access to the Mentorship feature.
